extraction.Name: Fannie Pilcher, nee Janis
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her land—160 acre allotment—at the time she got it, but was advised by the Indian Agency that she would have to accept it, so she did
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged this land to A. Barker, of Gordon, Nebraska, for $22.00, later he gave her $15.00, and again, in 1927, he gave her $25.00; and that she has not paid any of this money back; that early in the spring of 1928 he took her allotment away from her, and sold it to somebody else
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to A. Barker of Gordon, Nebraska for $22.00 (plus later payments of $15.00 and $25.00); Barker foreclosed in early spring 1928 and sold it to somebody else
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Mr. Barker claims that he paid the taxes on this allotment after the mortgage was once made
extraction.Occupation/Income: impossible for her to work; her mother supports her and her son
extraction.NOTES: Health is not good generally; left arm is crippled for two years since an automobile accident, making it impossible to work; divorced woman with one minor child who has weak lungs; mother supports her and her son; she considers she received a very, very poor price for her land; has never received any help from the County or Government; sworn November 20, 1928
